C1.worst_defect: The hero speaks to whoever installs the plugin, not to the owner whose staff will use it. Both buttons are 'Live demo' and 'Quick start', and the line under them reads 'Your own store needs the plugin on your Vendure server first'. The cashier guide, 'At the till', shows up only in the top nav and at the foot of the page, so nothing above the fold answers 'can my staff sell with this tomorrow'.

C2.worst_defect: The site is honest but leaves the owner with an open-ended dependency. The refund row says 'No, not on plugin 0.3.0: refund in the Vendure Dashboard. The refund stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls', and the 'Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0' badge gives no hint of when the till will refund on its own.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 / home.phone.04 (Live demo or your own store table); limitations.desktop.01

C3.worst_defect: The path to a working till asks the owner to repair the plugin's own role. Connect a till says 'On plugin 0.3.0 that role has no ReadOrder: add it yourself, or the till sells but its order history is refused', and quick start step 6 changes the store-wide tax strategy, which also affects the web shop. Either is easy for a freelancer to miss, and the counter then breaks in a way staff cannot diagnose.
C3.where: connect-a-till.desktop.01 (Give each cashier their own account, item 1); quick-start.desktop (step 6, tax strategy table)

C4.worst_defect: Troubleshooting is one page for both cashiers and developers. Plain counter notices sit next to errorCode lists, SuperAdmin GraphQL under 'Resolve a sale the store kept part-way', and VENDUREPOS_WEB_ALLOW_LAN_HTTP / connect-src. Limitations has the same problem in its till-update paragraph ('When the store refuses a till update … except a closure refused for its number, which it renumbers and sends once'). The At the till guide itself is clear and covers internet drops and closing the day well.

C5.worst_defect: Under 'What it does today' the two bordered cards are followed by a grid of feature items with no cards at all. The section changes weight halfway down and looks unfinished. Everywhere else the polish is good, including dark mode.
C5.where: home.desktop.01 (bottom, feature grid under the two cards)

C6.worst_defect: On phone the hero till screenshot shrinks to a narrow crop with two product tiles and a category chip cut to 'Gif'. On a phone between customers it shows almost nothing of what the till looks like. Code blocks with long identifiers (DefaultTaxLineCalculationStrategy) wrap awkwardly in quick start.

C7.worst_defect: Lighthouse mobile is 98/100/100/100. Its remaining flags are 53 KiB of unused JS, 130 ms of render-blocking resources and 14 KiB of legacy JS, with LCP at 2.3 s on / and 2.5 s on /docs/quick-start. llms.txt, the sitemap, JSON-LD, search and the 404 are all in order.

overall_worst.defect: On plugin 0.3.0 a real store cannot refund at the till. The home table says 'refund in the Vendure Dashboard. The refund stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls', so every counter refund turns into a call to the freelance developer. The home row never says who does this or where the steps are, even though Plugin setup has a 'Settle a Dashboard refund' section.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 / home.phone.04 (Live demo or your own store, Refunds row); limitations.desktop.01; at-the-till refund section
overall_worst.fix: In the home refund row and at the top of At the till's refund section, state the counter routine in one line: card terminal refund, Pay out on the till, manager files the Dashboard refund. Name who settles it and link straight to Plugin setup › Settle a Dashboard refund, so the owner knows today's routine and who to call.
